messages.text: What is non-signaling tester, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

A non-signaling tester, in the Rohde & Schwarz context here, is a radio/RF test instrument used for RF measurements in non-signaling mode, especially in WLAN production where all RF measurements are performed this way to save time; R&S positions the R&S CMP180 as optimized for that production non-signaling RF purpose [2], and raw evidence identifies the CMP180 as a Rohde & Schwarz Radio Communication Tester [67].
By contrast, raw evidence identifies the R&S CMX500 as a 5G one-box signaling tester [65], while the curated R&S context maps CMX500 to R&D signaling/interworking testing and CMP180 to production non-signaling RF testing [3].
| Decision | R&S product context | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Whether to choose a signaling or non-signaling platform | CMX500 is for R&D signaling/interworking; CMP180 is for production non-signaling RF testing [3]. Raw evidence also calls CMX500 a “5G one-box signaling tester” [65] and CMP180 a “Radio Communication Tester” [67]. | [3], [65], [67] |
| Which CMP180 measurement options to configure | CMP180 ordering includes non-cellular and cellular measurement packs, WLAN 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be SISO measurements, WLAN true MIMO 2x2/4x4 and 5x5/6x6 measurements, packet error rate acknowledgement measurements, LTE, NR FR1 single-carrier, multi-carrier and MIMO measurements [10], [11]. | [10], [11] |
| Whether WLAN production testing needs Wi‑Fi 7 / 802.11be support | CMP180 supports Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [2], and its options include WLAN IEEE 802.11be SISO measurements R&S CMP-KM352 [10]. | [2], [10] |
| Whether MIMO measurement capacity is needed | CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined for 4x4 MIMO access point testing [2]. CMP180 options also include WLAN true MIMO 2x2/4x4 R&S CMP-KM360 and 5x5/6x6 R&S CMP-KM361 [10]. | [2], [10] |
| Whether 6 GHz to 8 GHz and 500 MHz bandwidth hardware/options are needed | CMP180 has an extended frequency range option R&S CMP-K168 from 6 GHz to 8 GHz and a 500 MHz bandwidth option R&S CMP-K185 [43]; the specifications state IF bandwidth is 250 MHz basic and 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185, available only if R&S CMP-B805I or higher is installed [46]. | [43], [46] |
| Whether waveform playback/creation is needed in addition to measurements | CMP180 supports waveform creator, standard-specific waveform playback and R&S VSE analysis options, including WLAN 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax and 802.11be waveform options [13]. | [13] |
| Whether to treat CMX500 as only signaling, or also consider its non-signaling/GPRF use cases | CMX500 has a non-signaling GPRF generator use case for ARB, CW, dual tone and replay `.wv` waveforms [14], and its callbox material lists non-signaling verification and standalone TX measurements among example use cases [17], [20]. | [14], [17], [20] |
【推論】Understanding “non-signaling tester” mainly prevents confusing production RF measurement choices on CMP180 with R&D signaling/interworking choices on CMX500, because the passages explicitly separate CMP180 production non-signaling RF testing from CMX500 signaling/interworking testing [2], [3], [65], [67].

passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity › 重點摘要
- 來源未標示發布日期；raw frontmatter `created: 2026-09-11`，本文 ingest 日期為 2026-09-15。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱在最終 IEEE standard ratification 之前，已將 first [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 實作到 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester。
- 展示情境：[[MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[Rohde & Schwarz]] booth 5A80，Fira Gran Via Barcelona，hall 5。
- 測試對象：[[Broadcom]] prototype next-generation WLAN device / prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的焦點被描述為從 sheer speed 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）performance。
- 來源稱 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 延續 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 的 core PHY parameters：supported frequencies up to 7.125 GHz、channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz、4096QAM modulation、[[MLO]]。
- 來源列出 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的新 testing hurdles，包括 [[distributed resource units]]（dRU）與 [[unequal modulation]]（UEQM）。
- dRU measurements 被描述為可驗證 device boosting uplink transmit power 與 improving connection reliability 的 effectiveness。
- UEQM analysis 被描述為可評估 test device 是否能依 specified modulation coding scheme（MCS）combinations 正確 adapt modulation。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被定位為 modular、powerful one-box signaling tester，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR]] SA/NSA、[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]]、Direct-to-Cell（[[D2C]] / [[DTC]]）與 WLAN including [[Wi‑Fi 7]] and [[Wi‑Fi 8]]。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] — 新聞稿發布者與 [[R&S CMX500]] 供應商。
- [[R&S CMX500]] — multi-technology multi-channel one-box signaling tester；本來源新增 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] RF signaling mode 測試語境。
- [[Broadcom]] — 提供 prototype next-generation WLAN / [[Wi-Fi 8]] device 供展示驗證。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] — 對應 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment，來源稱其聚焦 [[UHR]]。

- [[IEEE 802.11bn]] — Wi-Fi 8 amendment；來源未標示標準版次或 ratification 狀態細節，只說 ahead of final ratification。
- [[UHR]] — Ultra-high reliability；來源稱為 Wi-Fi 8 的性能焦點。
- [[distributed resource units]] — Wi-Fi 8 PHY feature；來源寫作 dRU。
- [[unequal modulation]] — Wi-Fi 8 technology；來源寫作 UEQM。
- [[MLO]] — Wi-Fi 7 / Wi-Fi 8 延續的 Multi-Link-Operation。
- [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] — 展示場域。
- [[Christian Mokry]] — Press & media contact。

answer.text:
A non-signaling tester, in the Rohde & Schwarz context here, is a radio/RF test instrument used for RF measurements in non-signaling mode, especially in WLAN production where all RF measurements are performed this way to save time; R&S positions the R&S CMP180 as optimized for that production non-signaling RF purpose [2], and raw evidence identifies the CMP180 as a Rohde & Schwarz Radio Communication Tester [67].
By contrast, raw evidence identifies the R&S CMX500 as a 5G one-box signaling tester [65], while the curated R&S context maps CMX500 to R&D signaling/interworking testing and CMP180 to production non-signaling RF testing [3].
| Decision | R&S product context | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Whether to choose a signaling or non-signaling platform | CMX500 is for R&D signaling/interworking; CMP180 is for production non-signaling RF testing [3]. Raw evidence also calls CMX500 a “5G one-box signaling tester” [65] and CMP180 a “Radio Communication Tester” [67]. | [3], [65], [67] |
| Which CMP180 measurement options to configure | CMP180 ordering includes non-cellular and cellular measurement packs, WLAN 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be SISO measurements, WLAN true MIMO 2x2/4x4 and 5x5/6x6 measurements, packet error rate acknowledgement measurements, LTE, NR FR1 single-carrier, multi-carrier and MIMO measurements [10], [11]. | [10], [11] |
| Whether WLAN production testing needs Wi‑Fi 7 / 802.11be support | CMP180 supports Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [2], and its options include WLAN IEEE 802.11be SISO measurements R&S CMP-KM352 [10]. | [2], [10] |
| Whether MIMO measurement capacity is needed | CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined for 4x4 MIMO access point testing [2]. CMP180 options also include WLAN true MIMO 2x2/4x4 R&S CMP-KM360 and 5x5/6x6 R&S CMP-KM361 [10]. | [2], [10] |
| Whether 6 GHz to 8 GHz and 500 MHz bandwidth hardware/options are needed | CMP180 has an extended frequency range option R&S CMP-K168 from 6 GHz to 8 GHz and a 500 MHz bandwidth option R&S CMP-K185 [43]; the specifications state IF bandwidth is 250 MHz basic and 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185, available only if R&S CMP-B805I or higher is installed [46]. | [43], [46] |
| Whether waveform playback/creation is needed in addition to measurements | CMP180 supports waveform creator, standard-specific waveform playback and R&S VSE analysis options, including WLAN 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax and 802.11be waveform options [13]. | [13] |
| Whether to treat CMX500 as only signaling, or also consider its non-signaling/GPRF use cases | CMX500 has a non-signaling GPRF generator use case for ARB, CW, dual tone and replay `.wv` waveforms [14], and its callbox material lists non-signaling verification and standalone TX measurements among example use cases [17], [20]. | [14], [17], [20] |
【推論】Understanding “non-signaling tester” mainly prevents confusing production RF measurement choices on CMP180 with R&D signaling/interworking choices on CMX500, because the passages explicitly separate CMP180 production non-signaling RF testing from CMX500 signaling/interworking testing [2], [3], [65], [67].

- Multi-SIM 部分描述 DSDS / DSDA：1 DUT、2 SIM slots、2 parallel connections、1 CMX；DSDS 通常 one TX / 2 RX、2 SIMs standby、一次一個 active connection；DSDA 為 two TRX、2 SIMs active connection at a time；option 線索為 [[R&S CMX-KS600B]] NR Signaling SA/NSA 與 [[R&S CMX-KS613B]] Multi-SIM Enabler。
- Callbox example use cases 包含 R&D verification of new bands、sensitivity testing、RedCap、de-sense testing、3GPP pre-conformance、SRS measurements、UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements、UL TX Switching、Multi-SIM、high e2e TP testing 與 non-signaling verification。
- RedCap 部分稱 [[R&S CMX-KS617B]] NR R17 Signaling 用於 RedCap standalone，並列出 early identification via MSG1/MSG3、RedCap initial UL/DL BWP、NCD-SSB、LTE↔NR handover、eDRX、FR1/FR2 supported、Rel. Power Saving、UE measurement relaxation、PEI、PDCCH skipping。
- SRS / UL MIMO / UL TX Switching 部分稱 CMX supports all SRS modes / configurations，SRS measurements 可量測 TX power、EVM 等，[[R&S CMX-KS610B]] 用於 SRS carrier switching；UL MIMO RF measurements 提到 [[R&S CMX-KM604]] NR FR1 measurements MIMO、PC 1.5、29 dBm theoretical sum power for 2 TX antennas、UL FPTX、TX diversity、DFTS-OFDM。
- NTN 部分稱 comprehensive support for NR-NTN，multi-orbit：LEO、MEO、GEO、GSO，complete channel emulation in one box，live graphics for NTN orbits and parameters，NB-NTN coming end of `25，option 線索為 [[R&S CMX-KS627B]] NR Signaling Extension Rel-17。

CMX500_Callbox › 重點摘要
- High end-to-end throughput 部分稱 1024 DL QAM available in FR1、10.6 Gbps with 5CC SA verified、1CC FR1 + 8CC FR2、10 Gbps E2E testing，並列出 [[R&S CMX-KS610B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS637B]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA100]]。
- Non-signaling / GPRF 部分稱 GPRF Generator signal types 包含 ARB、CW、Dual Tone、Replay `.wv` files、up to 4 GPRF Generator instances in parallel、ARB Sequencer，且標示 no license required；但 technology-specific R&S provided ARB files 與 WinIQSim2 waveforms 由 KWxxx licenses enable。
- GPRF / ARB file 部分列出 KW libraries：GNSS [[R&S CMX-KW220]]、BT [[R&S CMX-KW310]]、WLAN KW350/KW351/KW352/KW353、GSM KW420、WCDMA KW440、LTE KW500、NB-IoT KW250、LTE C-V2X KW570、NR Rel 15/16 KW601、NR Rel 17 KW602 + KW601、NR C-V2X KW670、AWGN KW120；另有 [[R&S CMX-KW101]] Create ARB on CMX，coming with CSW 9.10。
- IQ recorder 部分稱可 record up to 4 Gbyte to a file、save files as `.wv` for replay、使用 same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling、2 per RFU、1 per IFU、FR1 specialist 可 8 instances in parallel。
- Standalone TX measurements 部分列出 [[R&S CMX-KM500]] LTE Measurements 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]] NR FR1 Measurements, Single Carrier。
- QDART support 部分稱 CMX500 officially listed for 5G Sub-6 / 2G–4G，WLAN internally verified and currently in process to get listed in Qualcomm help files。
